annotations.title: Mount Equipment into Rack Unit or Carrier Slot

description: Mount a new hardware device instance onto a rack unit or into a modular carrier bay in the active rack.yaml project and run 5-stage validation. 'instance_id' must be unique across both top-level devices and nested sub-modules, 'blueprint_slug' must reference an existing catalog or custom slug, and placement uses two mutually exclusive modes: 'u_position' with optional 'face' where the device's full U span fits within 1..u_height, or 'parent_carrier_id' plus a compatible 'slot_id' for sub-modules. Precondition errors such as duplicate 'instance_id', unknown 'blueprint_slug', or missing carriers return status 'INVALID' without mutating state, whereas 3D collision or PoE issues persist the mount, push an undo snapshot, and return remediation_suggestions. Use to add a new device instance; use modify_equipment to move, rename, or remove an existing instance, or plan_external_endpoints for off-rack room cable drops.

blueprint_slug.description: Catalog or custom hardware blueprint slug to instantiate.

face.description: Target rack mounting face ("front" or "rear") for direct rackmount equipment.

hostname.description: Optional logical hostname or display label shown in elevations and schematics.

instance_id.description: Unique project-wide instance identifier for this mounted device (e.g., "ups-u1", "sw-core-01").

parent_carrier_id.description: Mounted parent modular-carrier instance_id when mounting a sub-module (requires slot_id; mutually exclusive with u_position).

slot_id.description: Target bay slot_id inside parent_carrier_id when mounting a sub-module (e.g., "left-bay", "keystone-1").

u_position.description: 1-indexed lowest Rack Unit (U) when mounting directly onto the rack rails (mutually exclusive with parent_carrier_id/slot_id).
